Next Major Update is Almost Here!
This week we’re taking a short break from updates but that’s only because we’re preparing something big. The Next Major Update lands next week, bringing a set of new stations, systems, and missions to expand your universe.


New Stations
Oracle Station (Gossip) –> May whispers bring you reputation and intel.

Headquarters (Voting) –> Take part in decisions that shape the galaxy.

Crypt (Banking) –> Manage your resources and financial strategies.

DataCore (Crew Role Bonus) –> Unlock unique bonuses for your crew.

Blackmarket –> Purchase modules without reputation requirements.


New Missions
Fresh mission types will arrive, including Loan, Crew Upgrades, Gossip, and more.



We’re open to all kinds of feedback and ideas so if you’d like to help shape the future of the game, join us on Discord and let’s build it together!

notes.title: Language Update & Difficulty System
notes.notes:
Language Update

We’ve added Turkish language support to the game. This update includes UI translation, in-game text localization, and tutorial content in Turkish, aiming to offer a more immersive experience for our Turkish-speaking players. We’re also actively working on adding German and Spanish localization next. These translations are currently in progress and will be included in upcoming updates.

To make sure future localizations are as accurate and natural as possible, we would greatly appreciate help from native speakers. If you’re fluent in German, Spanish, or any other language and would like to contribute, feel free to join our Discord. Any support would mean a lot to us. 


Difficulty System


 In addition, a full difficulty system has been introduced. Players can now choose from four different difficulty levels: Chill, Easy, Normal, Hard. Whether you're looking for a relaxed exploration experience or a tough survival challenge, there's now a mode for every playstyle.
